problem_description: Compute the average temperature in K, pressure in bar, and density in kg/m^3 of the DPPC lipid bilayer system solvated in water. The system contained 100 DPPC lipid molecules and 3205 water molecules (spc/e) in a simulation box of dimensions 5.68585 × 5.60685 × 6.85739 nm³. Energy minimization was performed using the steepest descent algorithm for 100000 steps with a step size parameter of 0.002 using the Verlet cutoff scheme with neighbor list updates every step (nstlist = 1). Long-range electrostatic interactions were treated using the Particle Mesh Ewald (PME) method with a cutoff of 1.2 nm during energy minimization and 1.0 nm during equilibration and production runs, while van der Waals interactions were truncated at the same cutoff distances. Molecular dynamics simulations were performed using the md integrator with a time step of 0.002 ps and neighbor list updates every 5 steps. All bonds were constrained during the simulations. During the NPT equilibration the temperature should be set to 323 K, meanwhile the pressure should be set to 1.01325 bar and the pressure coupling type should be set as semiisotropic. The equilibration should be performed for 20 ps using the Nose-Hoover thermostat and Parinello-Rahman barostat with a coupling constant of 1.0 ps and 2.0 ps, respectively, and production run should use the same parameters as the equilibration run. PBC should be applied in the xyz directions. During the equilibration and production runs, the system compressibility was set to 4.5e-5
